column8: specifics: no concrete steps, e.g. ask which calls failed and when, check the call logs, and give a time for the next update || substance:reliability: nothing to protect the people being called meanwhile, e.g. a list of missed calls so staff can follow up by hand || substance:validate: nothing on closing the loop, e.g. following up with the root cause and what changed to prevent a repeat
